q2_gaps: pre-verbal "only" associating with a later constituent — the instruction set assigns the focus filler by "whichever constituent it sits on", which mechanically gives VP focus (the verb lemma) here, whereas the sentence's focus is plainly the PP object tense

an inherently reciprocal stative verb ("differ") with a bare group subject and no "from"-phrase — the Symmetric-relation route needs two arguments and has no slot for the "with respect to" restriction, and the instruction set does not say which routing wins over the ordinary event form
rendering a multiword preposition as an oblique head — the CamelCase-joining convention is stated only for inter-clause connectives ("as a result" -> AsAResult), not for preposition-named obliques
notes: The demonstrative plural correctly takes a group witness rather than Inheritance, "differ" is correctly treated as a stative intransitive (Experiencer) and as collective (no per-member distribution rule), and the bare simple present correctly gets no status atom. WithRespectTo counts as licensed under the preposition-named-oblique open class, and tense as a bare domain noun correctly stays a constant.
